_doc: Match rules shared by every map (SPEC 2.2, 5.6; AI_SPEC owner decisions). Contract file from W0; W1 reads spawnProtection* / protection*, W6 reads regroupSeconds / maxBots / difficulty. protectionEndsOnFire / protectionEndsOnThrow are the SPEC 2.2 [DECISION] (default on): firing any round (rifle, MG, rocket, emplaced gun) or releasing a grenade ends the shooter's own protection.
